name: @wyrcan/playtestr
description: Evidence-first autonomous playtesting for terminal games

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js run --manifest fixtures/turn-counter.json --profile explore --max-actions 10 --artifacts artifacts/smoke --trust-target
scripts.gauntlet: npm run build && node dist/cli.js gauntlet --suite fixtures/gauntlet.v1.json --artifacts artifacts/gauntlet --trust-target
